pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, sub-polygonal patches with rounded edges and soft pixel gradients; spatial area is larger on the neck, transitioning to smaller and more fragmented geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space separating dark patches; junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial; pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the neck but narrows toward the ventral margin.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dense, short mane along the neck with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background; consistent textural density from the upper neck to the shoulder.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an avian hitchhiker (Oxpecker) perched on the upper neck region, creating a localized pixel occlusion and distinct silhouette.
